name: VPN Chisel Tunnel
postCreateCommand: curl -sL -o /tmp/chisel.gz 'https://github.com/jpillora/chisel/releases/download/v1.11.8/chisel_1.11.8_linux_amd64.gz' && gunzip -f /tmp/chisel.gz && chmod +x /tmp/chisel && sudo cp /tmp/chisel /usr/local/bin/chisel && nohup chisel server --port 8080 --reverse --keepalive 25s > /tmp/chisel.log 2>&1 &
